turn.message: REA metadata run 45223376285 is valid read-only evidence. It found no Jellyfin-specific admin vault candidate in the checked locations, so Android device capabilities were not accessed. Do not inspect unrelated project secrets, reset credentials, claim a physical Android fix or redeploy. Native Android log/error remains required. An independent Jellyfin Android 2.7.3 report about Automatic quality becoming 1.5Mbps (#2227) and official Settings > Video player > Web player option justify a phone-only diagnostic, but do not prove cause without user retest.
